brief: The viewer observes a deep, underwater vista dominated by the massive skeletal remains of a clockwork network. Structures, rendered in oxidized bronze and porous cardboard, drift within a murky, mineralized space. Time appears to be the primary medium, as delicate flecks and sheets of rust continuously detach from the central machinery, spiraling downwards and dissolving into the background. The geometric arrangement of gears and housing units provides a rigid, decaying counterpoint to the gentle, constant downfall of memory. The entire scene perpetually shifts, emphasizing the slow, inevitable passage of time and the eventual dissolution of complex structures.
